transcript_probe.coverage_note: The authorized transcript reaches 01:13:15 of the 01:13:38 asset; the remaining tail is outro audio without substantive trading discussion.

timeline.claim: Twenty May 16 582 puts filled at 3.11 on an anticipated reversal before downside confirmation.
May 16 584 calls filled at 4.00 around 9:39, before the required five-minute OMG close.
The source acknowledged jumping the gun and reset the rules-based OMG record to a 4.07 entry and 4.31 target from the 9:40 bar.
The source rejected taking a reduced loss on the puts because four days remained to expiration.
The 584 calls traded at 4.33 and the source reported the 4.31 target achieved at about 9:51.
The source acknowledged that every downside call had been wrong while the market continued advancing.
The source disclosed additional unannounced high-risk trades whose entries and outcomes were not reconstructable.
The 582 puts remained open at a major loss; expiration and possible future profit taking were used to justify holding.

claims.label: DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL_BEFORE_CONFIRMATION
claims.claim: The 582-put trade relied on bearish divergence and extension before price confirmed a reversal.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: Synchronized bars, executable option path, exact target, MFE/MAE, and confirmed reversal baseline.

claims.label: PREMATURE_OMG_VERSUS_RULES_ENTRY
claims.claim: The source entered the upside OMG before the required close, while the reconstructed rules-based entry also reached target.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: Five-minute bars, exact option quotes at 9:39 and 9:40, fills, spread, slippage, and repeated OMG samples.

claims.label: TAPE_DISCONFIRMS_BEARISH_THESIS
claims.claim: Successive resistance breaks and sustained buying contradicted the bearish thesis, but the put remained open.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: Deterministic resistance and trend labels, put exit baseline, option path, and opportunity-cost replay.

claims.label: EXPIRATION_SUBSTITUTES_FOR_INVALIDATION
claims.claim: Remaining days to expiration were used to retain a failed intraday reversal trade without a price-based stop.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: End-of-day mark, next-day continuation, theta, MFE/MAE, and a predeclared stop baseline.

reported_trades.stop_or_invalidation: No price stop; retained because four days remained

reported_trades.entry_time: 00:17:21 actual early fill at 4.00; rules replay 4.07 at 9:40

conflicts: The actual 584-call fill preceded the rules-based OMG entry; both are retained separately in the evidence narrative.
